_note: What KIND of media a template's slots take. A separate axis from framing: framing answers HOW CLOSE, this answers WHAT IT IS. Three findings arrived at the same gap — the 3 templates where framing does not apply (user 2026-09-23: 'the undone 3 are for documents, screenshots and videos'), the briefs wanting the XXL Freshman cover and album artwork, and brief 23-23's 'screenshots in a document template'.
_kindNote: person = a photograph of someone. footage = a moving clip. document = an article, screenshot, or anything read as text. artwork = a cover, a sleeve, a poster. graphic = a chart or a generated image. A slot with no rule takes ANY kind.
_rule: RANKS, never excludes, like framing. An asset whose kind is UNKNOWN sits in the middle, never last — 660 of 1,381 assets carry no kind signal at all and punishing them would hide half the library.
